name: cultlib-monorepo
description: CultLib compatibility monorepo for GameCult persistence, protocol, and mesh packages.

scripts.build:ts: npm run build -w cultcache-ts && npm run build -w cultnet-ts && npm run build -w cultmesh-ts
scripts.typecheck:ts: npm run typecheck -w cultcache-ts && npm run typecheck -w cultnet-ts && npm run typecheck -w cultmesh-ts
scripts.test:ts: npm run test -w cultcache-ts && npm run test -w cultnet-ts && npm run test -w cultmesh-ts
